newsitem.title: USA: CNBC business channel plans schedule shift - NYT.
newsitem.headline: CNBC business channel plans schedule shift - NYT.

text.p: NBC's business news cable channel CNBC is planning changes in its prime-time schedule to better compete with Time Warner's Cable News Network, the New York Times said on Tuesday.
NBC is a unit of General Electric Co.
The Times reported CNBC planned to add a newscast programme anchored by Brian Williams to its nightly lineup in order to raise Williams' profile.
The new programme, scheduled to air May 19, will replace NBC's "Late Night with Conan O'Brien" programme, which has not produced strong ratings, the newspaper said.
In September CNBC will also start a roundup of the day's business event each weekday at 7 p.m. EDT, the newspaper said.
"We are looking at CNN," CNBC President Bill Bolster was quoted as saying in the paper.
